climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A region in Central Victoria where red grapes dominate plantings: Shiraz is 44 percent, Cabernet Sauvignon 18 and Merlot 13. It covers a large area.
